products.body_html:
Polar H10 Heart Rate Sensor – The Gold Standard for Accurate Heart Monitoring in India

If you’re serious about performance, the Polar H10 Heart Rate Sensor is your trusted partner in precision training. Designed for athletes, CrossFitters, runners, and fitness enthusiasts, the Polar H10 delivers ECG-grade heart rate accuracy that helps you understand your body in real time and train in the right zones.

 

At WOD Armour, we bring this globally acclaimed sensor to India with quick shipping, warranty support, and full app compatibility — so you can focus on performance, not tech issues.

 

 

 

Train with Proven ECG Accuracy

 

 

The Polar H10 is recognized worldwide for its exceptional heart rate tracking accuracy, especially during high-intensity and variable workouts like HIIT, powerlifting, and MetCon. Unlike optical sensors, which struggle with rapid movement or sweat, the H10 uses electrocardiogram (ECG) technology to monitor your heart with unmatched reliability.

 

This is backed by science. A clinical study comparing wrist-based monitors with chest straps confirmed that chest-worn devices like the Polar H10 heart rate monitor are significantly more accurate in tracking heart rate during various training intensities.

 

 

 

Dual Connectivity with Bluetooth® and ANT+

 

 

The Polar H10 offers dual connectivity, allowing you to pair it simultaneously with:

 

  • Your smartphone (via Bluetooth®)

  • Gym equipment, smartwatches, and bike computers (via ANT+)

 

 

Whether you’re using Strava, Polar Beat, Nike Training Club, Zwift, or syncing with Polar Flow, this sensor integrates smoothly with your training routine. It also supports simultaneous connections, so you can stream data to multiple platforms at once.

 

 

 

Train Without Your Phone

 

 

Unlike most heart rate sensors, the Polar H10 features internal memory, allowing you to track your session without needing your phone nearby. Simply sync later with the Polar Beat app and get a full breakdown of your performance stats.

 

This is especially useful for athletes who prefer minimal distractions during WODs, cycling, or swimming.

 

 

 

Polar Pro Strap – Comfort Meets Stability

 

 

The upgraded Polar Pro strap is soft, non-chafing, and stays firmly in place — even during fast-paced or high-sweat workouts. The electrodes are strategically integrated to improve accuracy while enhancing comfort.

 

With a water resistance of up to 30 meters, the Polar H10 heart rate monitor can easily handle Indian weather conditions, humid gyms, and swim sessions alike.

 

 

 

Long-Lasting Battery for Long-Term Training

 

 

Powered by a CR2025 coin cell battery, the H10 lasts for up to 400 hours of training — that’s months of intense workouts on a single battery. It’s also easy to replace, making it cost-effective over time.

 

 

 

Perfect for Indian Athletes and Coaches

 

 

Whether you’re a CrossFit athlete in Delhi, a marathon runner in Mumbai, or a cycling coach in Bangalore, the Polar H10 heart rate monitor gives you the insights needed to:

 

  • Optimize your heart rate zones

  • Improve cardiovascular efficiency

  • Track recovery and overtraining

  • Stay injury-free with accurate feedback

 

 

At WOD Armour, we understand the evolving needs of Indian athletes and deliver gear that performs — not just promises.

 

 

 

Why Buy from WOD Armour India?

 

 

  • ✅ 100% original Polar H10 heart rate monitor with manufacturer warranty

  • 🚚 Fast delivery across India (3–5 business days)

  • 📱 Expert assistance for app setup & connectivity

  • 🇮🇳 Local support, no import delays or hidden charges

 

 

 

 

Technical Specifications

 

 

  • Connectivity: Bluetooth® 4.0 & ANT+

  • Compatibility: iOS & Android, Polar watches, gym machines, Zwift, and more

  • Water Resistance: Up to 30m (suitable for swimming)

  • Battery Life: Up to 400 hours (CR2025)

  • Memory: Yes – stores one session independently

  • Strap Size: Adjustable (from 62 cm to 94 cm)

 

 

 

 

Conclusion

 

 

If you’re looking for a reliable, precise, and durable heart rate sensor in India, the Polar H10 Heart Rate Sensor is second to none. Trusted by elite athletes and validated by science, it empowers you to train smarter, recover faster, and perform at your best.

Training & Recovery with Polar Loop

 

 

Push harder, train smarter, and recover better with Polar Loop’s advanced tracking system designed to optimize every session and help your body perform at its peak.

 

 

Training Load Pro™

 

 

Every workout puts stress on your body’s cardiovascular and muscular systems. Training Load Pro™ measures this strain to give you a complete picture of how training impacts you — both immediately and over time.

 

  • Cardio Load: Understand how your heart responds to each workout.

  • Muscle Load: Track how much your muscles are being pushed.

  • Perceived Load: Record how hard each session feels to you.

 

 

Together, these insights help you balance intensity and recovery, avoid overtraining, and make every session count.

 

 

 

Training Recording via Polar Flow App

 

 

Start any workout, track your route, and monitor progress in real time with the Polar Flow App.

 

  • Use your phone’s GPS to map your training sessions.

  • Record and review performance data across all sports.

  • Access detailed metrics like pace, duration, and calorie burn directly in the app.

 

 

Your entire training history stays synced and accessible anywhere, helping you stay accountable and motivated.

 

 

 

Automatic Training Detection

 

 

Never miss a workout again. With Automatic Training Detection, your Polar device automatically detects and records training sessions — even when you forget to press start.

 

  • Detects elevated heart rate and activity to identify workouts.

  • Saves session data directly to your device.

  • Seamlessly syncs with the Flow App via Bluetooth.

 

 

This feature ensures every stride, rep, and ride is captured — letting you focus fully on training while your Polar handles the tracking.

products.title: Polar H9 Heart Rate Sensor
products.body_html:
Polar H9 Heart Rate Sensor – Reliable & Accurate Heart Rate Tracking for Everyday Athletes

Enhance Your Training with the Polar H9 Heart Rate Sensor

The Polar H9 Heart Rate Sensor is a top-tier heart rate monitor designed for fitness enthusiasts, casual exercisers, and athletes looking for accurate and reliable heart rate tracking. Whether you’re running, cycling, doing HIIT workouts, or practicing yoga, the Polar H9 ensures precise heart rate monitoring to help you train smarter and achieve your fitness goals.


With Bluetooth, ANT+, and 5 kHz connectivity, the Polar H9 is highly compatible with a variety of fitness apps, smartwatches, gym equipment, and cycling computers. Its long battery life, comfortable chest strap, and unmatched accuracy make it the perfect choice for those who demand precision in their training.

Key Features of the Polar H9 Heart Rate Sensor


✅ Accurate and Reliable Heart Rate Monitoring


The Polar H9 uses an ECG-based heart rate sensor that delivers precise readings, making it more accurate than wrist-based optical sensors. It is ideal for high-intensity workouts, endurance training, and calorie tracking.


✅ Multi-Device & App Compatibility


Seamlessly connect the Polar H9 to a wide range of devices via:

• Bluetooth (compatible with iOS & Android apps like Polar Beat, Strava, and Nike Run Club)

• ANT+ (for Garmin devices, Peloton bikes, and gym equipment)

• 5 kHz transmission (for real-time heart rate tracking in swimming and group fitness classes)


✅ Comfortable & Adjustable Chest Strap


The Polar Soft Strap provides a snug yet comfortable fit, ensuring the sensor stays in place during intense workouts. The high-quality materials prevent irritation and allow for long-term use.


✅ Extended Battery Life


With an impressive 400-hour battery life, the Polar H9 can last up to 12 months on a single CR2025 battery (based on one hour of daily use), reducing the need for frequent replacements.


✅ Water-Resistant & Durable


The Polar H9 is water-resistant up to 30 meters (IPX5), making it suitable for sweat-heavy workouts and outdoor training in varying weather conditions.


✅ Affordable Yet High-Performance


The Polar H9 delivers premium heart rate monitoring at an affordable price, making it an excellent option for beginners and seasoned athletes alike.

Who Should Use the Polar H9?


The Polar H9 Heart Rate Sensor is perfect for:

✔️ Runners & Cyclists – Monitor real-time heart rate and optimize your training zones

✔️ HIIT & Gym Enthusiasts – Improve workout intensity with precise tracking

✔️ Swimmers & Rowers – 5 kHz transmission ensures accuracy even in water

✔️ Yoga & Pilates Practitioners – Monitor heart rate variations during sessions

✔️ Fitness Beginners – Get insights into heart rate and calorie burn

Why Choose the Polar H9 Over Other Heart Rate Sensors?

• More accurate than wrist-based heart rate monitors

• Longer battery life compared to other chest strap monitors

• Seamless connectivity with multiple fitness apps and devices

• Budget-friendly without compromising on quality

Buy the Polar H9 Heart Rate Sensor Today!


Upgrade your training with the Polar H9 Heart Rate Sensor and experience superior heart rate tracking with unmatched accuracy and reliability. Whether you’re an athlete or just starting your fitness journey, the Polar H9 will help you train smarter and achieve better results.
